INTTEGRO_API_KEY.description: A dedicated Inttegro server API key. Cloud Run exposes it only to server code; use Secret Manager for production workloads.

INTTEGRO_DEMO_PRODUCT_ID.description: The active Kora Market Product ID.

INTTEGRO_DEMO_PRICE_ID.description: An active Price ID belonging to the configured Product.

APP_KEY.description: Required. Generate with `php artisan key:generate --show`; do not reuse the Inttegro API key.

APP_DEBUG.description: Prevent detailed exception output from reaching visitors.

SESSION_DRIVER.description: Use encrypted cookies so the demo needs no database.
